an4.29:1.1: cattārīmāni bhikkhave dhammapadāni aggaññāni rattaññāni vaṃsaññāni porāṇāni asaṃkiṇṇāni asaṃkiṇṇapubbāni na saṃkīyanti na saṃkīyissanti appaṭikuṭṭhāni samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi
an4.29:1.3: anabhijjhā bhikkhave dhammapadaṃ aggaññaṃ rattaññaṃ vaṃsaññaṃ porāṇaṃ asaṃkiṇṇaṃ asaṃkiṇṇapubbaṃ na saṃkīyati na saṃkīyissati appaṭikuṭṭhaṃ samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi
an4.29:4.1: sammāsamādhi bhikkhave dhammapadaṃ aggaññaṃ rattaññaṃ vaṃsaññaṃ porāṇaṃ asaṃkiṇṇaṃ asaṃkiṇṇapubbaṃ na saṃkīyati na saṃkīyissati appaṭikuṭṭhaṃ samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi
an4.29:4.2: imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri dhammapadāni aggaññāni rattaññāni vaṃsaññāni porāṇāni asaṃkiṇṇāni asaṃkiṇṇapubbāni na saṃkīyanti na saṃkīyissanti appaṭikuṭhṭhāni samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhīti.
